descr: Kimi K3 vs Kimi K3.1 Pro: the two models are evenly matched in chat performance.
risposta: The blind Arena vote finds Kimi K3 and Kimi K3.1 Pro about even. Both receive the same chat score of 1487. No clear winner emerges from the data. Choose based on secondary factors such as coding strength or personal preference.
dimensioni: Both models are roughly the same size, with Kimi K3.1 Pro at 2780.1 B (104.8 B active) and Kimi K3 at 2779.9 B (104.6 B active). Each requires a 4-bit download of about 1686 GB. The tiny difference in active parameters does not affect the overall storage requirement.
velocita: At 4-bit precision with an 8K context, neither model fits on any of the listed home machines. RTX 3090, RTX 4090, RTX 5090, RX 7900 XTX, Mac M4 Max 128 GB, and Ryzen AI Max+ 395 128 GB all report that the models do not fit. Running them locally would need larger GPU memory or off-load solutions not covered here.
gratisA: Kimi K3.1 Pro can be used for free by downloading the open weights and running the model at home under the Kimi K3.1 Pro License. No free API or trial page is available on FreeLLMArena.
gratisB: Kimi K3 is also free to use by downloading the open weights and running the model locally with the Kimi K3 license. Like its sibling, it lacks a free API or trial option on FreeLLMArena.
sceglieA: Pick Kimi K3.1 Pro if coding performance matters most; it scores 1684 in the coding category, outpacing Kimi K3. The chat score is identical, so the coding edge can be decisive for developers.
sceglieB: Pick Kimi K3 when you prefer the original model or when you value the slightly higher vote count it received (43 641 votes versus 6 011 for the Pro version). Its chat performance matches the Pro version, making it a solid all-round choice.

categorie.Chat: Both Kimi K3.1 Pro and Kimi K3 achieve a chat score of 1487, indicating they perform equally well in conversational tasks.
categorie.Coding: Kimi K3.1 Pro leads in coding with a score of 1684, while Kimi K3 scores 1658, giving the Pro version a modest advantage for programming assistance.
